work.title: Untitled (Guernica with CDs) 1
work.description: Monochrome photographic imagery of a WWII German warplane viewed from below occupies the upper half, while scattered compact discs and cassette-tape mechanisms populate the lower section against a pale architectural background. Iridescent CDs labeled 'SKILCRAFT' are distributed across the composition alongside chain-linked cassette reels.
work.composition: warplane above scattered CDs and cassettes
